verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows in passing that Mailchimp has 'automations': Analytics AI explains which campaigns and automations drive revenue, and a community user mentions helping with an automation. Nothing documents how those automations are built or what they can do. Missing for 10: documentation of multi-step workflow building, welcome/onboarding/winback series templates, conditional branches, time delays, exit rules, and independent hands-on corroboration.
